items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Eugene Porter. Eugene Porter. He was about the greatest clarinet player that I ever heard in my life.

ctx.x: Well who were some of your favorite say clarinet players when you were coming up?

Willie Hoffman. Mm-hmm. Or Wiggles was playing nice clarinet then. Wiggles. You mean Pernell? Yeah, we call him Wiggles. That name just comes from. Wiggles. Yeah. Mm-hmm. Back in those days, we had Jesse. What Jesse name? He got killed in Walter Barnes. What is his name? He got born up Jesse's. Him. I can't remember. We had Porter. Porter was about the greatest here. Eugene Porter. Eugene Porter. Eugene Porter. He was about the greatest clarinet player that I ever heard in my life. Yeah.
Mm-hmm. I don't know if he plays clarinet at all now. I don't know. He's alive.
